story: Burr Pond State Park is a forest and public recreation area covering 438 acres in the town of Torrington, Connecticut. It surrounds Burr Pond, an 85-acre man-made body of water created in 1851.
matters: The park is adjacent to Paugnut State Forest. A trail across Paugnut State Forest connects the park with Sunnybrook State Park.
name: Burr Pond State Park
